<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

`record_confidences` blocked the CPU on the previous step's confidence copy at every step, adding 3-5 ms prefill latency to DSpark adaptive verification (AV). Wait in `get_num_tokens` instead, only when drafts are scheduled.

## Claims

- Removes AV's prefill overhead vs. fixed K, with unchanged acceptance.
- Full-model (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) results to follow.

## Validation

Small [DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark](https://huggingface.co/inference-optimization/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-2.1B-A1.9B-small) (dummy weights), 1×H100, 8K random prompts, 16 output tokens, c=1, 3 trials. Server prefill time (`vllm:request_prefill_time_seconds`):

| branch | variant | prefill (ms) | AL |
|---|---|---|---|
| main | K=5 | 47.7 ✅ | 5.76 |
| main | K=5 + AV | 51.2 🐌 | 5.74 |
| this PR | K=5 + AV | 46.6 ✅ | 5.76 |

<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

```bash
vllm serve inference-optimization/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-2.1B-A1.9B-small --load-format dummy \
  --max-model-len 16384 --max-num-seqs 16 --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --compilation-config '{"max_cudagraph_capture_size":4096}' \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","enable_adaptive_verification":true}'

aiperf profile --model inference-optimization/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-2.1B-A1.9B-small --endpoint-type chat --streaming \
  --prompt-corpus random --synthetic-input-tokens-mean 8192 --output-tokens-mean 16 --extra-inputs ignore_eos:true \
  --concurrency 1 --benchmark-duration 30 --server-metrics http://127.0.0.1:8000/metrics
```
</details>

## Details

- **Root cause:** the previous step's copy is ordered after all its GPU work, so syncing on it right after launching the next step stalled the CPU (profile: extra `cudaEventSynchronize` after prefill, identical GPU work).
- **Fix:** wait one step later, when the budget reads the copy. By then it has landed, so the wait is free.
- **Pending-reset list → step counters:** a row is used only if its copy is newer than its request, otherwise 1.0. Same behavior, but no CPU writes into buffers with in-flight copies.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
